name: alternate lateral pulldown
description: A cable lat pulldown done one handle at a time, building the lats with a stretch and squeeze on each side.
instructions: Sit on a bench under a high pulley with a single handle attached.
Reach up and hold the handle in one hand, arm straight.
Pull the handle down to the side of your shoulder, driving your elbow toward your ribs.
Let it rise slowly until your arm is straight.
